import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int h = scanner.nextInt();
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        String binaryRep = Integer.toBinaryString(n - 1);
        binaryRep = "0".repeat(h - binaryRep.length()) + binaryRep;
        int total = 0;
        boolean flipState = true;
        for (int position = 0; position < h; position++) {
            char bit = binaryRep.charAt(position);
            if (bit == (flipState ? '1' : '0')) {
                total += Math.pow(2, h - position);
            } else {
                flipState = !flipState;
                total += 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
